milestones.label: Final selection results communicated
milestones.time_text: From the second half of November 2026
milestones.source_text: The AGCID Nelson Mandela call for 2027 (official, May 2026) says final results will be communicated from the second half of November 2026. Chilean embassies must enter shortlisted candidates on the AGCID platform by 30 October 2026, 23:59 Chile time. Classes can start from the first week of March 2027.
